name: @juspay-tech/react-native-hyperswitch-vault
description: Hyperswitch card form for React Native. Authored in ReScript, published as JavaScript with genType-generated TypeScript declarations.

scripts.build: node scripts/check-submodule.mjs && node scripts/verify-icon-coverage.mjs && rescript && node scripts/check-generated.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/clean-bundles.mjs && rollup -c && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs && node scripts/emit-package-type.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.consumer.json
scripts.prepack: node scripts/check-submodule.mjs && node scripts/verify-icon-coverage.mjs && rescript && node scripts/check-generated.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/clean-bundles.mjs && rollup -c && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs && node scripts/emit-package-type.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.consumer.json
scripts.verify: node scripts/verify-icon-coverage.mjs && node scripts/verify-result-mapping.mjs && node scripts/verify-tarball.mjs && node scripts/verify-consumers.mjs
scripts.build:clean: rescript clean && node scripts/clean.mjs && node scripts/check-submodule.mjs && node scripts/verify-icon-coverage.mjs && rescript && node scripts/check-generated.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/clean-bundles.mjs && rollup -c && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs && node scripts/emit-package-type.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.consumer.json
